body:
## Disposition
Credited already_solved, 0/5 new author turns. Free convex-cocompact groups in real hyperbolic four-space have a uniform limit-set Hausdorff-dimension gap below 3, independent of rank. This is Lewis Bowen’s published 2015 result, not a new discovery.

## Corrected dependency and review
The later Abért–Bergeron–Biringer–Gelander 2021/2023 repair of Bowen’s random-net approximation dependency is explicit. CORRECTED_APPLICATION.md checks all-radius volume bounds, every-net ambient nerve estimates, boundary control and the compact-lattice interleaving argument. The independent review passes the exact original source and corrected theorem chain. No numerical optimal gap or statement for geometrically infinite full limit sets is claimed.

## Verification
All nine frozen source-verification artifacts and five review files are unchanged; two additive public wrappers document current status and portable replay. Standard-library checks reproduce 58,717 author and 80,000 independent assertions. Raw sources/imports are excluded. Fresh main is first parent and source WIP is second parent. Only this target folder and its own QUEUE status cell change; turns remain 0/5. Draft only, no merge/release or CI-pass claim.
title: 6200082: credit Bowen’s negative Schottky dimension result with repaired proof chain
